videos.title: ✅ How to Install PrestaShop on Localhost in Windows 11 Using XAMPP
videos.description: This video provides a step-by-step tutorial on installing PrestaShop on a Windows 11 system. It demonstrates the process of setting up PrestaShop on a localhost environment using XAMPP.

videos.title: Comment installer PrestaShop en ligne | PrestaShop tutoriel FR | #howto #tutorial
videos.description: This tutorial demonstrates the online installation of PrestaShop. It covers downloading the platform, configuring web hosting and a domain name, using an FTP client to transfer files, and executing the PrestaShop installation wizard to create an e-commerce store.

videos.title: Come installare PrestaShop 1.7 su un server web | #howto  #tutorial
videos.description: Guide to installing PrestaShop 1.7 on a web server: covers prerequisites (PHP and extensions), downloading and extracting the PrestaShop archive, uploading files via FTP (FileZilla), creating a MySQL/MariaDB database, and completing the guided installer.
